findings.claim: Legacy same-action retry stays false after compensation
findings.evidence: Parent reran the binary-backed probe: four retries return false and scratch stays absent. New recovery-retaining fingerprint conflicts with the own legacy Aborted marker; supported fully validated legacy compensation must not strand the same action.

findings.claim: Interrupted cleanup rejects its own delete envelope
findings.evidence: Parent reran deterministic cleanup twice: the retry returns recovery-manifest-unavailable because the new preflight attempts original-owner recovery on the cleanup batch itself before its known deterministic batch can resume.

Parent reproduced an expired first write followed by occupied CreateOnly: Indeterminate/compensation-race despite no own unresolved writes. CompensateAsync requires an envelope for the skipped ordinal.

findings.claim: Legacy compensation accepts invalid selected generation
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced ActiveGeneration=-1 through public RecoverPendingAsync: it reports resolved and removes private bytes. The partial legacy Building check omits complete epoch validation before destructive compensation.

findings.claim: Missing fixed v2 durable-identity golden vectors
findings.evidence: Current deadline test round-trips production encoder/decoder while only v1 has a fixed byte/fingerprint vector. A coordinated v2 serialization drift can silently change retained identity; a mixed-retention fixed vector is missing.

Repository tests cover prepared journal restart and deadline mutation serialization separately. No case persists deadline-bearing prepared catch-up mutations, replaces the coordinator, crosses expiry and verifies physical absence plus coherent completion.

findings.claim: Missing physical Redis COW expiry coverage
findings.evidence: The selected/inherited/abandoned COW deadline cases use a fake retaining physical bytes. Current live classes prove basic physical expiry but not that selected inherited/previous-pointer reads remain available after actual Redis removal.

findings.claim: Missing real-Dapr legacy compensation interruption coverage
findings.evidence: The new immutable legacy compensation row and transitions are tested only in recording/in-memory stores. Live named dispatcher cases use retained-manifest batches, leaving physical CAS/evidence cleanup after legacy-compensator interruption unqualified.

findings.claim: No near-limit proof through the real owner-proof HTTP endpoint
findings.evidence: The near-limit case directly reads the real Dapr SDK proof then carries its actual result through the production gateway via fixed HTTP. Full endpoint routing/binding is unchanged and separately exercised by production HTTP harnesses. Remaining combination adds negligible confidence and requires more than a direct correction; reject under the low-finding rule.

The expired-wrapper success cases and ordinary compaction races do not exercise a newer write after the physical expired-wrapper read but before installation/transaction dispatch. Both supported profiles need explicit persisted newer-byte preservation evidence for the changed CAS path.

findings.claim: Prepared scratch has no discoverable participant envelope
findings.evidence: Parent reran the actual dispatcher regression at BeforeInstallOperation ordinal0: Abort remains Accumulating/Indeterminate. MarkerPrepared is the same no-participant state; its original retained manifest exists, but key recovery and terminal reclamation never consume it.

Pre-verified gap: the current race advances to the deadline, so IsCompacted accepts the newer row before the new pre-expiry preservation branch. Non-retained unexpired retry lacks its own persisted-newer-row assertion.

findings.claim: Missing promoted expiring pointer abandoned-replacement test
findings.evidence: Pre-verified gap: current abandonment seeds a generation-zero anchor; streamed expiry writes an unrelated key. No test covers copying LatestExpiresAtUtc from an already promoted same-key pointer into PreviousExpiresAtUtc before Abort.
